fato_historico: 1849: Passaleão incident: João Maria Ferreira do Amaral, the governor of Portuguese Macau, is assassinated by a group of Chinese locals, triggering a military confrontation between China and Portugal at the Battle of Passaleão three days after.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you may encounter moments where firm boundaries are tested, much like historical shifts in tides. Consider this a time to stand tall in your convictions. Your ambition is a powerful force, but softness remains your greatest ally today. Allow yourself the grace to navigate complex transitions with the steady heart of a mountain climber reaching new, serene peaks.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the gentle courage to stand firm yet remain open.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of grand dreams through structured and steady action.
conselho: Choose diplomacy over conflict when facing unexpected resistance in your daily path.
